==Notes==
*The Facet of Existence has a random spawn location in Riven Earth. Known spawn locations:
*#Northwest of the [[Golem Foundry]].
*#Directly east from [[Rata Sum]], before the second [[resurrection shrine]].
*#Up the hill slightly southwest of the center resurrection shrine.
*#Northeast of center, northeast of the short bridge north of center, between the northern and northeastern resurrection shrines (see map).
*#Southeast corner, in the raised area overlooking the waterfall from the north.
*As the first spawn point is so close to Rata Sum, it may be worth reloading the map until you get this spawn. It can be reached without combat.
